The serialize/deserialize round-trip itself is fine (75.3 MB blob, pager restored from it). The bug is that after `deserialize()` restores the pager for the boundary (637 tokens), the **delta prefill** (positions 637-1008) calls `hybrid_forward_one_token` which writes KV to **logical positions** without calling `slot_for()` — so positions beyond the pool (637-1008 > 512) write OOB, corrupting the pager mapping, and decode fails.

The fix is straightforward: call `slot_for(committed)` before each delta token and pass the physical slot to `pipelined_decode_one_token`.
